concept: JACCL silent hang on peer loss
summary: #3910 captured a live `sample` showing 1156 of 1304 StreamThread samples inside MeshImpl::recv, calling tbt_poll_cq and tbt_poll_qp_recv, with ring_indicies_err on the error path polled in a loop

facts.text: #3910 captured a live `sample` showing 1156 of 1304 StreamThread samples inside MeshImpl::recv, calling tbt_poll_cq and tbt_poll_qp_recv, with ring_indicies_err on the error path polled in a loop
The main thread of a hung rank sits in Event::wait on IOSurfaceSharedEvent waitUntilSignaledValue, so SIGTERM is never delivered and SIGKILL leaves wired pages held until reboot
#3910 reproduced on 4x Mac Studio M3 Ultra, macOS 26.4.1 and 26.5 mixed, mlx 0.32.0, TB5 full mesh
Re-plugging the Thunderbolt cable about a minute after the drop did not unblock the in-flight operation
The same hang signature appeared once after about 75 h of continuous serving with no physical action and no captured trigger
On 2x M4 Pro mini with macOS 26.5.1, SIGKILL of rank 1 left the survivor at 100% CPU in all_reduce with 1927 of 2009 samples in tbt_poll_cq
On the same M4 Pro hardware a physical unplug crashed both ranks instead of hanging
#4278: a SIGSTOPped rank froze the other three at the same iteration at 99-100% CPU, and SIGCONT let all four resume with no corruption
Setting en2, en3 and en4 down with ping at 100% loss did not stop a four-rank RDMA collective, since established queue pairs bypass the IP stack
mlx.launch kills the surviving ranks when any rank exits, which hides what survivors would do
Ring backend on peer loss: v0.32.0 hangs, main aborts with exit 134, #3742 gives a catchable RuntimeError
Ring issue #3862 is closed; its fix PR #4060 merged as commit 8c28c38
Ring SocketThread::worker returned after 10 failed attempts without resolving pending promises, so every rank blocked in Event::wait; the ring also lacks SO_KEEPALIVE
PR #4060 chose to exit the process on peer loss because resolving the promises makes survivors return wrong collective results silently
Throwing from the stream thread reaches std::terminate because StreamThread::thread_fn calls task() with no try/catch
TN3205 states RDMA over Thunderbolt supports send and receive only, at most 10 UC queue pairs, messages up to 16,773,120 bytes and 4095 outstanding work requests
The only integration pattern reported before any fix is an application no-progress watchdog that SIGKILLs ranks and reboots leaked nodes
